headline: values of different types are combined
reason: Comparing or combining values of different types is an error (reference 3).

headline: no visible function has this dot-call name
reason: A dot call looks in the type's module, then among the names in scope (reference 5.4).

headline: a choice arm is a catch-all
reason: A whole arm over a choice type can't be _ or a name; list the cases (reference 7.2).

headline: an argument's type doesn't match its parameter
reason: A call passes each argument to its corresponding parameter (reference 5.2).
